transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Hello, Doctor. Thank you so much for seeing me, I really appreciate it. I hope I'm not taking up too much of your time. 

Um... I guess what brings me in is... well, I just don't seem to have the push I used to have. For things like my choir, or my quilting, or even just visiting folks. It's probably nothing to worry about, really, I try not to make a fuss. But most days I just end up sitting at home with the TV on low. I know people are expecting me, and I feel just awful about letting them down. 

Does that make sense, Doctor? I hope that's the kind of thing I'm supposed to tell you.
Has this lack of drive or low mood been going on most days for at least two years?

Well... yes, I suppose it has. I hope I'm not making a mountain out of a molehill, but... it's been building up since I retired from the school office. That was just a little over two years ago now. 

I kept thinking I'd just snap out of it on my own, you know? I really didn't want to be a bother to anyone, so I just kept quiet about it. Am I... is that what you needed to know, Doctor? I want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things most days?

Oh, no, I don't think so. I mean... I have my little frets now and then, just like anybody else would, I suppose. But I wouldn't call myself a worrywart or anything like that. 

I mostly just try to take things as they come. Since I'm just sitting at home anyway, there isn't too much to get worked up over. I try to keep a peaceful mind so I don't bother anyone with a lot of complaining. Is that... does that help answer what you were looking for, Doctor? I hope I'm explaining it right.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Oh, no, I wouldn't say that at all. I still dearly love my choir, and my quilting... they're such lovely things. It's just... well, like I mentioned before, I just don't seem to have the get-up-and-go to actually go out and do them right now. 

But I still enjoy the thought of them, and I love hearing about what the other ladies are making when they call. So the interest is still there, I just... I just end up staying home instead. I hope I'm not confusing things by saying that, Doctor. Am I explaining it alright for your notes?
